duplicate_definition: Identical normalized float32 spectrogram content; cross-split cases were also confirmed as byte-identical source WAV files.

post_canonicalization.semantic_effect: Physical files were deduplicated; all historical v1 logical rows and array values were preserved.

historical_v1_split_audit.interpretation: Physical deduplication prevents duplicate storage but does not remove duplicated logical examples from a manifest.

future_content_safe_v2.use: Use these versioned manifests for future experiments; retain v1 manifests only to reproduce recorded results.
